scan_applies_to: The original release-preparation snapshot, before subsequent public repository edits.
scope: Historical pattern and allowlist review of the recorded snapshot; not proof of absence of all secrets and not a new scan of subsequent repository edits.

current_release_status.data_rights_boundary: The code license does not establish redistribution rights for private geospatial inputs or derived records.

subsequent_functional_validation.validated_snapshot: The updated public download checked after restoration of the missing manifests, before subsequent documentation edits.
subsequent_functional_validation.scope: Manifest, configuration, source/result integrity and lightweight functional checks; not a new credential scan or end-to-end reproduction with private inputs.

maintenance_note: Preserve these historical scan measurements. A new scan of a later repository version must record its own findings and identify the scanned version.
